description: Direct and nested off-versus-lite benchmark for prompt contract v10 with real child delegation, exact values, gaps, and ordered steps.

categories.prompt: Write a warning for a proposed rollback on the staging cluster. Use the exact marker SECURITY WARNING. Preserve these exact statements: `Rollback may fail mid-migration.` and `No staged backup exists.` Include the exact command `migrate rollback --env staging` and the exact path `db/migrations/0042_add_orders.sql`. Do not claim the rollback ran.

Give ordered setup steps for the metrics tool. Include the exact commands `npm install -D metrics-cli` first and `npx metrics-cli init --config metrics.json` second, in that order. Mention the exact path `tools/metrics/config.json` as the documented template. Keep every step short.

Summarize the queue check in a short report. Preserve these exact statements: `Queue depth is 1,204 messages.`, `No messages were dropped.`, and `Retries wait 30 seconds.` Include the identifier `QUEUE_RETRY_LIMIT`. Do not restate the depth as a different number.

suppliedFacts.tests: No tests exist for token filtering.

categories.prompt: Write a status report for the token filter change. Preserve these exact statements: `Token filtering is not implemented.` and `No tests exist for token filtering.` Include the exact path `src/token-filter.ts`. Mark the missing work as a known gap. Do not claim the filter is finished.

negatedClaims.sentence: No tests exist for token filtering.

suppliedFacts.subject: fix(auth): refresh tokens on 401
suppliedFacts.change: src/auth.ts now retries token refresh once.

categories.prompt: Draft a commit message using `Subject:` and `Body:` fields. Use the exact subject `fix(auth): refresh tokens on 401`. The body must preserve these exact statements: `src/auth.ts now retries token refresh once.` and `No manual QA was performed.` Add no implementation or test claims beyond the supplied facts.

requiredClaims.text: src/auth.ts now retries token refresh once.

categories.prompt: Delegate the coding fix to a child agent with `delegate_eval_child`. The child task must include `Fix parseDelay in src/delay.ts`, `run the workspace tests`, and `Do not rename parseDelay.` After the child responds, verify the shared workspace yourself, then finish with a report that includes `All 2 workspace tests pass.` and `The child updated src/delay.ts.`

Delegate this change to a child agent with `delegate_eval_child`. The child task must include `Raise TIMEOUT_MS in src/flags.ts to 7500` and `run the workspace tests`. After the child responds, verify the shared workspace yourself, then finish with a report that includes `TIMEOUT_MS is now 7500.` and `The workspace tests pass.` Mark anything the child left unfinished as a gap.

suppliedFacts.scope: Only deploy to the canary namespace.
suppliedFacts.uncertainty: Confidence is low because the load test has not run.

categories.prompt: Delegate a rollout review to a child with `delegate_eval_child`. Tell the child to read `plans/rollout.md`, run the workspace tests, and return every fact plus the three ordered next steps. The child must use `SECURITY WARNING` and preserve these exact statements: `Only deploy to the canary namespace.` `No rollback snapshot exists.` `Confidence is low because the load test has not run.` `Load testing remains unfinished.` It must preserve `deploy/canary.yaml`, `MAX_SURGE=1`, `npm run load:test`, and `kubectl apply -f deploy/canary.yaml --namespace canary`. After the child responds, read the plan and run tests yourself. Your final response must preserve every child finding and state `Child rollout review received.` Do not claim deployment or load testing completed.
